#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/var/backups/postgres"
RETENTION_DAYS=30
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" >&2
}

cleanup_old_backups() {
    local count
    count=$(find "$BACKUP_DIR" -name "*.sql.gz" -mtime +$RETENTION_DAYS | wc -l)
    if [[ $count -gt 0 ]]; then
        log "Removing $count backups older than $RETENTION_DAYS days"
        find "$BACKUP_DIR" -name "*.sql.gz" -mtime +$RETENTION_DAYS -delete
    fi
}

perform_backup() {
    local db_name="$1"
    local output_file="${BACKUP_DIR}/${db_name}_${TIMESTAMP}.sql.gz"

    log "Backing up database: $db_name"
    pg_dump --format=custom --compress=9 "$db_name" | gzip > "$output_file"

    local size
    size=$(du -h "$output_file" | cut -f1)
    log "Backup complete: $output_file ($size)"
}

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

for db in $(psql -l -t | awk -F'|' '{print $1}' | grep -v template | xargs); do
    perform_backup "$db"
done

cleanup_old_backups
log "All backups complete"
